title: You thought words had power.
paragraphs: You thought curses could shape destiny.
You thought if someone spiritual enough spoke against you… it would stick.
But then there’s this moment in Scripture that shatters that entire belief system.

“How can I curse whom God has not cursed?
How can I denounce whom the Lord has not denounced?”
The Scene You Didn’t Realize You Were Living In
A pagan king—Balak—terrified of Israel’s growth, hires a prophet-for-hire: Balaam.
To speak destruction over God’s people.
Money is offered. Pressure is applied. Altars are built. Rituals are performed.
Every time Balaam opens his mouth to curse…
But Here’s What Most People Don’t Realize…
You’ve believed words over your life:

“You’ll never change.”
“You’re too far gone.”
“God could never want you.”
You built your identity around them.
The Real Reason Balaam Couldn’t Curse Israel
It wasn’t because Balaam lacked power.
It was because God had already spoken.
“God is not man, that He should lie… Has He said, and will He not do it?”
They complained. They sinned. They doubted.
And no external curse could override what God had already declared.
Spiritual Diagnosis: You’re Listening to the Wrong Voice
You’re crippled by agreement with lies.
If you are in Christ, no curse has authority over you.
But if you are outside of Christ, you’re already under something worse than a curse—
“Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us…”
On the cross, every accusation, every judgment, every sentence against sin—
So that anyone who repents and believes…
is no longer defined by what was spoken over them—
but by what Christ finished for them.
while still living outside His covenant.

Still under sin, vulnerable, exposed, and deceived
or
Covered by Christ, redeemed, and sealed by grace
The Truth That Breaks Every Curse

No word spoken against you stands
No accusation defines you
No past owns you
What Will You Do With That?
Will you keep replaying what people said?
Or will you submit to what God has declared?
